What you can ask Darvy to do

## Real things, said out loud, done end-to-end.

- → Read me my unread emails and let me reply to the ones that matter.

- → Write me a one-page intro about myself and save it to a Google Doc.

- → Search the web for noise-cancelling headphones under $200.

- → Schedule a 30-minute call with Sarah next Tuesday afternoon.

- → Send a message on WhatsApp to my brother saying I'll be late.

Hold the right Alt key and speak. Release when you finish. Darvy interrupts itself the moment you start speaking — no awkward "is it my turn?" silence.

How it works

## Three steps. No setup tax.

#### 1 — Download

### Install on your computer

Download the Windows installer. NVDA or Narrator guides you through every prompt — no GUI gymnastics. Mac installer launching soon.

#### 2 — Sign in

### Connect your accounts

Authorise Google (email, calendar, docs). Optionally connect more. Darvy reads your screen and uses your existing logins — credentials never leave your machine.

#### 3 — Talk

### Say what you want done

Hold the right Alt key and speak. Darvy reads back what it's doing as it works, so you always know where you are.
